summary: Implemented split_amount in ledger/split.py following docs/CONVENTIONS.md (integer cents, conservation, leftover cents to earliest parties, refunds split on absolute value then negated, ValueError for non-positive party counts) and added tests; 19 tests pass.
assumptions: Amounts are integer cents per docs/CONVENTIONS.md and ledger/money.py, so split_amount(1000, 3) returns [334, 333, 333].
Non-integer inputs (floats, bools) raise TypeError; conventions forbid floats for money but do not specify the error, so this is a reversible choice.
A zero total with a valid party count returns a list of zeros (valid and non-empty).
